arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-02' AND date < '2019-11-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in the 30 days that end on the last day in the data, with that last day counted as one of the 30.
assumptions: I took 'the last 30 days' to end on the last day in the data, 2019-10-31, not on today's date.
The 30-day window runs from 2019-10-02 through 2019-10-31, with both days included.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, a negative amount or an error.
